description: Execution-isolation posture (Repair B, a separate guarantee from the append-failure invariant): the runtime reports its real effective uid/gid, the declared non-root requirement is evaluated against live process identity, a root runtime refuses with an explicit environment-incompatibility result instead of a silent pass, and a complete-sandbox claim is never derivable from identity alone.
notes: rcos-eval/1 with a private adapter: this eval measures the RUNTIME's posture,
not a capability's domain work, so it declares its own reporter instead of
invoking reuse-ledger through the invocation kernel. It is independent of the
The adapter records posture.json (execution posture + the live evaluation of
the declared requirement) into the run work dir; the gates re-read it beside
the live process identity they themselves run under, prove both branches of
the requirement evaluator with injected postures (deterministic at any uid),
and never allow a complete-sandbox claim.
